purpose: Extend the current-checkpoint six-TRAIN inference and positive learning control with a bounded, length-matched actually-consumed Web TRAIN versus separate Web DEV teacher/free history diagnostic. Describe observed fit gaps and free-generation failures; do not infer a unique cause, required training quantity, or generalization from exact-reference mismatch alone.
TRAIN_selection: Replay all eight actual initial committed updates of the unchanged source sampler. Every cumulative original-token digest, draw trace and teacher count must equal actual training history. Select the first16 distinct Web full-unit first windows with original body64..512, excluding the previously measured six source hashes. Retain original source order. If insufficient, stop; no extra draws or reselection.
DEV_selection: Only the first4096 records of the existing separate accepted Web DEV index. Match each TRAIN body length to the closest unused eligible DEV body64..512, breaking ties by original DEV index. Reject duplicate selected body hashes or any selected TRAIN/DEV hash overlap. These are observational length-matched samples, not random representative estimates or a new protected test.
prefix: Original UTF8/codec-stable body boundary: first such cut24..48 tokens, unchanged original BOS2 and continuation targets including only actual EOS. Missing valid boundary is a preparation failure, not a reroll.
inference: Same frozen actual sequential2B, BF16/math, cached greedy64, suppression[0,1,2,4,5,6,7], EOS3. Gold-history and free-history from identical prefixes. Reuse the verified six-case history function. No optimization, altered cap, synthetic EOS, source edits, or decoder sweep.
reporting: All32 teacher/free raw records, original IDs/bytes/source and actual first-prediction equality. Full individual reading of all32 free continuations with premise/nonprogressive repetition notes; old Base80 scores and gates unchanged. Compare original-reference NLL only on common positions and disclose that divergent valid continuations need not match gold. Real goldEOS reported only when in64-token interval; otherwise null.
predeclared_fit_gap_screen: Report token-weighted teacher NLL and original-token argmax for each population. A seen-versus-unseen fit gap is supported only descriptively if mean paired (DEV minus TRAIN) document teacher NLL>0.25 nats and its paired bootstrap95% CI is wholly>0. Length matching does not make the samples equivalent in topic, style or memorization exposure. Non-trigger means no such gap demonstrated in these samples, not proof of adequate training or absence of overfitting.
completion: Actual exited<=120seconds process, all16 pairs/32 raw outputs individually read, fixed parent and unchanged model/RNG/eval-mode checks, closed persistent PID/boot/start GPU ledger, original10B idle UI restored, CPU summary and local commit. No training launch automatically follows this diagnostic.
limits: Only Web and initial consumed windows; do not generalize to all sources or learning history. Repetition judgments are diagnostic observations, not a replacement acceptance criterion. Current checkpoint trained on2B gold, not the discarded six-case memorization probe.
